Attack choreography: mandibles part, legs crouch, then snaps and lunges forward; cyan internal fluid. All 36 cells contain only this same creature.

Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: pixel-art combat VFX sprite sheet for this existing game. Reference is the game's original painted pixel explosion style. Create a SQUARE 1536x1536 atlas with EXACTLY EIGHT equal columns and EIGHT equal rows, 64 192x192 cells, on perfectly flat #ff00ff magenta key background, no grid lines or text. Each row eight animation frames left-to-right. Row 1 green acid glob with irregular wet trailing droplets, looping. Row 2 violet spore/needle projectile with jagged tail, looping. Row 3 cyan electric plasma projectile crackling, looping. Row 4 orange burning seed/fire projectile, looping. Row 5 top-down circular ragged white/gray shockwave ring expanding and dissolving, ring fits entirely in each cell. Row 6 horizontal white/gray energy beam between left and right edges in every cell, narrow jagged lightning and heated core with animated irregular edges, no arrows. Row 7 white/gray impact sparks and fluid bursts, explosion progression. Row 8 white/gray irregular spinning liquid droplets and tiny curved torn shell fragments, animation progression. White rows will be tinted by the game. Retain dense textured 1990s shooter pixel clusters, black contour pixels, colorful highlights. Flat illustrated sprites only, never voxel cubes or low-poly shapes. Keep cell grid exact and every effect within its cell.
